mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, sales_platform, shop_id, shop_name, source_type, source_id, source_code, outstock_id, outstock_code, channel_id, order_time, delivery_time, transport_no
mapper.select: SELECT lbd.id AS detailId, lb.id, lb.sales_platform AS salesPlatform, lb.shop_id AS shopId, lb.shop_name AS shopName, lb.source_type AS sourceType, lb.order_type AS orderType, lb.source_id AS sourceId, lb.source_code AS sourceCode, lb.outstock_id AS outstockId, lb.outstock_code AS outstockCode, lb.channel_id AS channelId, lb.order_time AS orderTime, lb.delivery_time AS deliveryTime, lb.transport_no AS transportNo, lb.to_country AS toCountry, lbd.track_no AS trackNo FROM logistics_bill_detail lbd LEFT JOIN logistics_bill lb ON lbd.main_id=lb.id ANd lb.is_deleted=false WHERE lbd.is_deleted=false AND lbd.track_no=#{trackNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT lb.outstock_id AS outstockId FROM logistics_bill_detail lbd inner JOIN logistics_bill lb ON lbd.main_id=lb.id ANd lb.is_deleted = false WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and lbd.is_deleted = false

SELECT lb.id, lbd.id as detailId, lb.outstock_id as outstockId, lb.transport_no as transportNo, lb.outstock_code as outstockCode, lb.shop_id as shopId, lb.shop_name as shopName, lbd.track_status as logisticsStatus, lbd.track_content as logisticsTrack, lb.counter_no as counterNo, lb.carrier_id as carrierId, lb.source_code as businessCode, lb.invoices_status as invoicesStatus, lb.shipping_method as shippingMethod, lb.remark, lb.channel_id as logisticsChannelId, lb.logistics_supplier_id as logisticsSupplierId, lb.to_country as toCountryName, (select sum(lbcd.cost_value) from tms_cost_detail lbcd left join logistics_bill_cost lbc on lbc.id = lbcd.main_id and lbcd.is_deleted =false where lbc.logistics_bill_id = lb.id and lbcd.TYPE = 'estimated') as estimatedFee, lb.ship_time as shipTime, lb.order_time as orderTime, lbd.sign_time as signTime, lb.remark, (select lbcd.exchange_rate from tms_cost_detail lbcd left join logistics_bill_cost lbc on lbc.id = lbcd.main_id and lbcd.is_deleted =false where lbc.id = lbcd.main_id and lbcd.is_deleted =false and lbcd.TYPE = 'estimated' limit 1) as exchangeRate, case when lb.ship_time is not null then FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-lb.ship_time))/3600) else FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-lb.order_time))/3600) end as actualHour from logistics_bill lb inner join logistics_bill_detail lbd on lbd.main_id = lb.id and lbd.is_deleted = false where lb.id = #{id} and lb.is_deleted =false limit 1

SELECT case when lb.ship_time is not null then FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-lb.ship_time))/3600) else FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-lb.order_time))/3600) end as actualHour, lc.effective_time as effectiveTime, lb.shop_id as shopId from logistics_bill lb inner join logistics_channel lc on lb.channel_id = lc.id where lb.is_deleted =false and lc.is_deleted = false and lb.order_time is not null and lc.effective_time != '0' and lb.order_type = #{orderType}
${permissionSql}

select lb.outstock_code as outstockCode, lb.source_code as sourceCode, lb.transport_no as transportNo, lbc.actual_weight || lbc.weight_unit as weight, lbc.volume_weight || lbc.weight_unit as volumeWeight, lbc.weight_logistics || lbc.weight_unit as weightLogistics, lbc.volume_weight_logistics || lbc.weight_unit as volumeWeightLogistics, lbc.currency, lbc.id as costId from logistics_bill lb inner join logistics_bill_cost lbc on lb.id = lbc.logistics_bill_id inner join logistics_bill_detail lbd on lbd.main_id = lb.id where ${params.sqlMap.default} and lb.order_type = #{params.orderType} and lb.is_deleted =false and lbc.is_deleted = false and lbd.is_deleted = false
${params.permissionSql}

SELECT lb.id, lb.shop_id as shopId, lb.outstock_id as outstockId, lb.transport_no as transportNo, lb.counter_no as counterNo, lb.source_code as businessCode, lb.outstock_code as outstockCode, lbd.track_status as logisticsStatus, lbd.track_content as logisticsTrack, lb.invoices_status as invoicesStatus, lbc.reconciliation_status as reconciliationStatus, lb.shipping_method as shippingMethod, lb.channel_id as logisticsChannelId, lb.logistics_supplier_id as logisticsSupplierId, lb.shop_name as shopName, lb.to_country as country, lbc.actual_weight as weight, lbc.volume_weight as volumeWeight, lbc.weight_unit as weightUnit, (select sum(lbcd.cost_value) from tms_cost_detail lbcd where lbc.id = lbcd.main_id and lbcd.is_deleted =false and lbcd.TYPE = 'estimated') as estimatedFee, (select sum(lbcd.cost_value) from tms_cost_detail lbcd where lbc.id = lbcd.main_id and lbcd.is_deleted =false and lbcd.TYPE = 'actual') as actualFee, lbc.currency as currency, lb.order_time as orderTime, lbd.sign_time as signTime, lb.remark, case when lb.ship_time is not null then FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-lb.ship_time))/3600) else FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-lb.order_time))/3600) end as actualHour from logistics_bill lb inner join logistics_bill_cost lbc on lb.id = lbc.logistics_bill_id inner join logistics_bill_detail lbd on lbd.main_id = lb.id inner join logistics_channel lc on lc.id = lb.channel_id and lc.is_deleted = false where lb.order_type = #{params.orderType} and lc.effective_time != '0' and lb.order_time is not null and lb.is_deleted =false and lbc.is_deleted = false and lbd.is_deleted = false

SELECT lbd.id AS detailId, lb.id, lb.sales_platform AS salesPlatform, lb.shop_id AS shopId, lb.shop_name AS shopName, lb.source_type AS sourceType, lb.order_type AS orderType, lb.source_id AS sourceId, lb.source_code AS sourceCode, lb.outstock_id AS outstockId, lb.outstock_code AS outstockCode, lb.channel_id AS channelId, lb.order_time AS orderTime, lb.delivery_time AS deliveryTime, lb.transport_no AS transportNo, lb.to_country AS toCountry, lbd.track_no AS trackNo FROM logistics_bill_detail lbd LEFT JOIN logistics_bill lb ON lbd.main_id=lb.id ANd lb.is_deleted = false WHERE lbd.is_deleted = false and lb.source_type = 'soB2c' AND (lbd.track_no = #{logisticsCode} or lb.transport_no = #{logisticsCode}) LIMIT 1
